about_the_game:
This work is a visual novel game with the script written by Mr. Routuanzi, the characters drawn by Mr. Luzi, and co-produced by SNOWKEDO.

The DEMO version does not have dubbing. The official version will have cute dubbing of the heroines.

Game Story

Zhang Fulai, who was originally an ordinary store clerk, accidentally obtained a robot that can change its appearance - Airi.

The robot Airi obeys Zhang Fulai's orders and will satisfy whatever Zhang Fulai asks for.

Until Zhang Fulai discovered that Airi could also transform into other people.

Airi can imitate both the appearance and the voice perfectly.

What would Zhang Fulai do at this time?

Who will Airi become?

Will he close the door, or let Airi transform into someone else and blend into the crowd?

Character

Annie Chen is a convenience store clerk and a devil. He speaks very directly, to everyone, but he has some feelings for someone.

Phyllis, a college student, is not from an art college, but has the temperament of an art college. She keeps a distance from everyone, but is particularly special to the bishop... right?

Airi, it's a robot, a sex robot. No matter what I do, it won't resist. It's even very happy that I'm "using" it.

content_descriptors.notes:
Normal male-female sexual behavior, containing adult themes, including violence and vulgar language.

No reference to sexual assault/non-consensual sex, BDSM, drug/alcohol abuse, and/or self-harm.

short_description: Have you ever fantasized about “her”? In your imagination, what would you want to do to “her”? If someone looked exactly like her—wouldn’t resist, wouldn’t call the police, and would submit to your every desire—would you be willing to confront the darkness in your heart?
